ops.title: cc-notes: first-class event feed RPC to replace viz-server spawning
ops.description: Deferred from the cc-pane v1 plan. cc-pane v1 spawns `cc-notes viz --no-open --port 0` per viewed repo and consumes /api/graph — process-lifecycle overhead (leak risk on hard kill) and a per-repo server. Expose the classified event feed as a first-class surface (Go package, RPC, or unix socket per the user's original suggestion) so cc-pane can read timelines without spawning servers.
